project.name: Smart Parking System
project.organization: Sample University - School of Information Systems
project.author: CSE703095 Course Team
project.description: A case-study system for managing a multi-floor parking lot: vehicle entry and exit, slot allocation, fees, reservations and zone control, used to illustrate the requirements-engineering lifecycle across CSE703095 chapters 1-8.

requirements.title: Vehicle entry
requirements.description: The system shall issue a ticket and assign an available slot of the matching vehicle type when a vehicle enters.
requirements.rationale: Core entry workflow.
requirements.acceptance_criteria: A ticket with entry time is created and the assigned slot is marked occupied.

requirements.title: Slot availability display
requirements.description: The system shall display the number of free slots per floor and zone.
requirements.rationale: Drivers need to know where space is.
requirements.acceptance_criteria: Displayed counts equal the number of free slots in each floor and zone.

requirements.title: Exit and fee calculation
requirements.description: The system shall calculate the parking fee as started hours multiplied by the hourly rate of the vehicle type when a vehicle exits.
requirements.rationale: Core revenue function.
requirements.acceptance_criteria: Outside peak hours and below 80% occupancy, fee equals ceil(hours parked) x hourly rate for the vehicle type.

requirements.title: Payment
requirements.description: The system shall accept cash or online payment before the exit barrier opens.
requirements.rationale: Ensures every stay is paid.
requirements.acceptance_criteria: The barrier opens only after the fee is paid.

requirements.title: Slot reservation
requirements.description: The system shall allow a driver to reserve a slot in advance and hold it until 15 minutes after the arrival time.
requirements.rationale: Guarantees space for planned visits.
requirements.acceptance_criteria: A reserved slot is never assigned to another vehicle and is released after a 15-minute no-show.

requirements.title: Locate vehicle
requirements.description: The system shall allow a driver to find the slot of a parked vehicle by plate number.
requirements.rationale: Saves time in large lots.
requirements.acceptance_criteria: Search by plate returns the floor, zone and slot of the vehicle.

requirements.title: Lost ticket handling
requirements.description: The system shall let attendants look up the entry record by plate number, charge the maximum daily fee plus a penalty, record the incident in the audit log, and notify the manager and print a receipt.
requirements.rationale: Drivers sometimes lose tickets.

requirements.title: Zone lock
requirements.description: The system shall allow an administrator to lock or unlock a floor or zone so that no new vehicle is assigned to it.
requirements.rationale: Needed for maintenance and events.
requirements.acceptance_criteria: Slots of a locked zone are never assigned; vehicles already parked are not affected.

requirements.title: Role-based access control
requirements.description: The system shall restrict administrative functions to authenticated administrator accounts.
requirements.rationale: Security requirement.
requirements.acceptance_criteria: An attendant account cannot lock or unlock a zone.

requirements.title: Audit log of transactions
requirements.description: The system shall log every entry, exit, and payment transaction.
requirements.rationale: Required for compliance audits.
requirements.acceptance_criteria: Each transaction has a log record with a timestamp.

requirements.title: Plate recognition
requirements.description: The system shall read the plate number from the entry camera image and fall back to manual entry when the recognition confidence is below 80%.
requirements.rationale: Removes manual typing at the gate.
requirements.acceptance_criteria: A read with confidence of at least 80% is accepted automatically; below 80% the attendant is asked to enter the plate.

requirements.title: Nearest slot assignment
requirements.description: The system shall assign the free slot of the vehicle type with the shortest walking distance to the gate.
requirements.rationale: Saves drivers time and shortens queues.
requirements.acceptance_criteria: Among free slots of the vehicle type, the one with the smallest distance to the gate is assigned.

requirements.title: Sensor reconciliation
requirements.description: The system shall raise an alert when a slot sensor reading does not match the ticket records.
requirements.rationale: Sensors are the ground truth for slot state.
requirements.acceptance_criteria: A vehicle detected in a slot without a ticket, or a ticketed slot reported empty, produces an alert; a silent sensor blocks its slot.

requirements.title: Overstay alert
requirements.description: The system shall alert the attendant when a vehicle has been parked longer than 24 hours.
requirements.rationale: Detects abandoned vehicles.
requirements.acceptance_criteria: An alert is raised once the stay exceeds 24 hours.

requirements.title: Emergency evacuation
requirements.description: The system shall open all barriers and stop issuing tickets when an evacuation is triggered.
requirements.rationale: Life safety requirement from the fire inspector.
requirements.acceptance_criteria: After the trigger all barriers are open, exits are free of charge and no new ticket is issued.

requirements.title: Peak-hour pricing
requirements.description: The system shall multiply the hourly rate by 1.5 for each started hour that begins between 07:00 and 09:00 or between 17:00 and 19:00.
requirements.rationale: Raises revenue and spreads demand (CR-01).
requirements.acceptance_criteria: A started hour that begins in a peak period is charged at 1.5 times the hourly rate.

requirements.title: Occupancy surcharge
requirements.description: The system shall add a 25% surcharge to the fee when the occupancy of the vehicle type exceeds 80% at entry.
requirements.rationale: Discourages entry when the lot is nearly full (CR-01).
requirements.acceptance_criteria: A vehicle entering when occupancy of its type exceeds 80% is charged 125% of the fee.

requirements.title: Staff authentication
requirements.description: The system shall authenticate staff accounts with a password and lock an account after 3 consecutive failed attempts.
requirements.rationale: Administrative functions need a verified identity.
requirements.acceptance_criteria: Valid credentials return the account role; the third consecutive failure locks the account.

requirements.title: Reservation cancellation
requirements.description: The system shall allow a driver to cancel a reservation and shall release the slot immediately.
requirements.rationale: Unused reservations block other drivers.
requirements.acceptance_criteria: A cancelled reservation frees its slot for other vehicles at once.

requirements.title: Lot and rate configuration
requirements.description: The system shall allow an administrator to change the hourly rate and add a zone while the lot is running.
requirements.rationale: The operator must adapt prices and capacity without downtime.
requirements.acceptance_criteria: A new rate applies only to tickets issued after the change; the slots of a new zone are assignable at once.

requirements.title: Revenue report
requirements.description: The system shall report the revenue per floor and zone for a selected period.
requirements.rationale: Management reviews income by area.
requirements.acceptance_criteria: Zone revenues add up to the floor revenues and the floor revenues to the total of the payments in the period.

requirements.title: Manual fee override
requirements.description: The system shall apply a manual fee correction only after a manager or an administrator has approved the request of an attendant.
requirements.rationale: A wrong fee must be fixable at the booth without opening a way to fraud (HZ-02, HZ-12).
requirements.acceptance_criteria: An approved override replaces the fee at exit; a request without a reason, or an approval by an attendant, is refused; request and decision are in the audit log.

requirements.title: Monthly pass and VIP
requirements.description: The system shall charge no parking fee to a vehicle whose plate holds a valid monthly or VIP pass.
requirements.rationale: Regular customers want a flat contract and VIP customers want a reserved place.
requirements.acceptance_criteria: A vehicle with a valid pass pays 0 VND for parking; after the end date it pays the normal fee; VIP slots are assigned only to VIP pass holders.

requirements.title: EV charging slots
requirements.description: The system shall assign a vehicle of type EV only to a free EV charging slot, and no other vehicle type to such a slot.
requirements.rationale: Implements CR-02: dedicated charging zones.
requirements.acceptance_criteria: An EV gets a free EV slot; a car never gets an EV slot; with no free EV slot the entry is rejected.

requirements.title: EV charging fee
requirements.description: The system shall add the charged energy multiplied by the energy price to the fee of an EV.
requirements.rationale: Charging cost must be recovered (CR-02).
requirements.acceptance_criteria: Fee = parking fee + kWh x 3500 VND; a zero or negative reading is rejected.

requirements.title: Exit plate verification
requirements.description: The system shall keep the exit barrier closed when the plate read at the exit differs from the plate of the ticket.
requirements.rationale: Stops ticket swapping and theft of a parked vehicle (HZ-10).
requirements.acceptance_criteria: A mismatch or an unreadable plate keeps the barrier closed, raises an alert and is logged; an attendant approval lets the vehicle leave.

requirements.title: Grace period
requirements.description: The system shall charge no fee for a stay of 15 minutes or less.
requirements.rationale: Drivers who turn around at once should not pay a full hour.
requirements.acceptance_criteria: A stay of 15 minutes costs 0 VND; a stay of 16 minutes costs one started hour.

requirements.title: Daily fee cap
requirements.description: The system shall limit the fee of each started 24 hours to 10 times the hourly rate before the occupancy surcharge.
requirements.rationale: Long stays should have a predictable maximum.
requirements.acceptance_criteria: A 24 hour stay costs at most 10 x the hourly rate; a 25 hour stay costs the capped first day plus the started hours of the second day.

requirements.title: Offline gate operation
requirements.description: The system shall keep the gates working for entry, exit and evacuation when the connection to the central server is lost.
requirements.rationale: Gates must not stop when the network fails (HZ-11).
requirements.acceptance_criteria: In offline mode vehicles enter and leave with cash or card payment, and evacuation opens the barriers; online payment, reservation and pass registration are refused with a clear message.

requirements.title: Synchronization after offline mode
requirements.description: The system shall mark every record made offline and clear the marks when the connection returns.
requirements.rationale: The central records must be complete after an outage.
requirements.acceptance_criteria: Records made offline carry an offline mark; on reconnection their number is logged and the marks are cleared.

requirements.title: Barrier interlock
requirements.description: The system shall keep a barrier open while a vehicle is detected in its path or its presence sensor fails.
requirements.rationale: A closing barrier must never strike a vehicle (HZ-04).
requirements.acceptance_criteria: A close command is refused and logged when a vehicle is present, the sensor fails or power is lost; otherwise the barrier closes.

nfrs.title: Slot assignment response time
nfrs.description: Slot assignment shall be fast enough not to hold up the entry gate.

nfrs.title: System availability
nfrs.description: The gate system shall be available during operating hours.

nfrs.title: Usability for attendants
nfrs.description: New attendants shall be able to process a lost-ticket case without extensive training.

nfrs.title: Data protection
nfrs.description: Plate numbers and payment data shall be encrypted at rest and in transit.

nfrs.title: Scalability
nfrs.description: The system shall support growth in the number of floors and slots.

nfrs.title: Evacuation response time
nfrs.description: All barriers shall open quickly once an evacuation is triggered.
nfrs.metric: time from trigger to all barriers open

actors.name: Driver
actors.description: A person who parks a vehicle and pays the fee.

actors.name: Gate Attendant
actors.description: Staff who assist drivers at the gates and handle lost tickets.

actors.name: Parking Administrator
actors.description: Manages lot structure, zones and system configuration.

actors.name: Entry Camera
actors.description: Camera at the entry gate that captures plate images.

actors.name: Slot Sensor
actors.description: Sensor in each slot that reports whether a vehicle is present.

actors.name: Fire Alarm
actors.description: Building fire alarm that can start an evacuation automatically.

actors.name: Parking Manager
actors.description: Reviews revenue and audit data and handles escalations.

actors.name: Charging Station
actors.description: Charger that reports the energy delivered to an EV.

actors.name: Central Server
actors.description: Back-office server for reservations, passes and online payments; may be unreachable.

actors.name: Exit Camera
actors.description: Camera at the exit gate that captures plate images.

use_cases.title: Vehicle entry
use_cases.goal: Park a vehicle in an available slot
use_cases.preconditions: A free slot of the vehicle type exists; the lot is not evacuating
use_cases.main_flow: Driver arrives at the entry gate;System reads the plate number and vehicle type <<include UC-07>>;System finds the nearest available slot of matching type <<include UC-08>> <<extended by UC-18>>;System issues a ticket with an ID and the entry time;System shows the assigned slot and opens the entry barrier, which closes after the vehicle has passed
use_cases.alternative_flows: [step 3] If no free slot of the vehicle type exists, system rejects entry and shows 'zone full';[step 3] If a slot is reserved for this plate, system assigns the reserved slot;[step 2, exception] If the plate is already inside the lot, system rejects the entry
use_cases.postconditions: Ticket created; slot marked occupied; barrier closed again
use_cases.trigger: Vehicle arrives at the entry gate

use_cases.title: Exit and pay
use_cases.goal: Pay the parking fee and leave
use_cases.main_flow: Driver presents the ticket at the exit gate;System checks the entry time and the plate <<include UC-21>>;System calculates the fee by started hours <<extended by UC-11>> <<extended by UC-17>>;Driver pays the fee by cash, card or online via the Payment Gateway;System prints the receipt, frees the slot and opens the exit barrier
use_cases.alternative_flows: [step 1] If the ticket is not found, system refuses the exit and directs the driver to the attendant <<extended by UC-06>>;[step 4, exception] If payment fails, the barrier stays closed and the driver retries or changes the payment method;[step 4, exception] If the Payment Gateway is unavailable, online payment is refused and the driver pays cash or card at the booth
use_cases.postconditions: Ticket closed; fee and receipt recorded; slot free

use_cases.title: Reserve a slot
use_cases.goal: Reserve a slot before arriving
use_cases.preconditions: A slot of the requested type is free
use_cases.main_flow: Driver selects the vehicle type and the arrival time;System finds a free slot;System marks the slot reserved for the plate;System confirms the reservation
use_cases.alternative_flows: [step 2] If no free slot exists, system rejects the reservation;[step 3, exception] If the driver does not arrive within 15 minutes after the arrival time, system releases the reservation
use_cases.postconditions: Reservation recorded; slot reserved

use_cases.title: Locate my vehicle
use_cases.goal: Find where the vehicle is parked
use_cases.main_flow: Driver enters the plate number;System searches the active tickets;System displays the floor, zone and slot with the distance from the gate
use_cases.alternative_flows: [step 2] If the plate is not found, system shows 'vehicle not found'
use_cases.postconditions: Location displayed

use_cases.title: Lock or unlock a zone
use_cases.goal: Block a floor or zone from new vehicles, or reopen it
use_cases.preconditions: Account exists; lot is not evacuating
use_cases.main_flow: Administrator authenticates <<include UC-12>>;Administrator selects a floor or zone;Administrator chooses lock or unlock;System blocks the free slots (lock) or frees the blocked slots (unlock) of that branch;System confirms and logs the change
use_cases.alternative_flows: [step 4] If occupied slots exist in the branch, they stay occupied until the vehicles leave and then become blocked;[step 4] If reserved slots exist in the branch, they keep their reservation;[step 4] On unlock, slots whose sensor is faulty stay blocked;[step 1, exception] If the account is not an administrator, system denies access
use_cases.postconditions: Locked branch is not assigned to new vehicles; unlocked branch is assignable

use_cases.title: Handle lost ticket
use_cases.goal: Let a driver without a ticket exit
use_cases.preconditions: Driver is at the exit gate without a ticket
use_cases.main_flow: Attendant enters the plate number;Attendant checks the identity and proof of ownership of the driver;System looks up the entry record;System charges the maximum daily fee plus the penalty;System frees the slot and logs the incident
use_cases.alternative_flows: [step 3] If no entry record is found, the attendant escalates to the Parking Manager;[step 2, exception] If the driver cannot prove ownership, system refuses the exit and notifies the Parking Manager
use_cases.postconditions: Ticket closed; incident logged

use_cases.title: Recognize plate at entry
use_cases.goal: Identify the vehicle automatically at the entry gate
use_cases.preconditions: Entry Camera is online; vehicle is stopped at the gate
use_cases.main_flow: Driver stops at the entry gate;Entry Camera captures the plate image;System reads the plate number with a confidence score;System accepts the plate when confidence is at least 80%;System continues with the vehicle entry
use_cases.alternative_flows: [step 4] If confidence is below 80%, system asks the attendant to enter the plate manually;[step 2, exception] If the Entry Camera is offline, system switches to manual entry and logs the fault
use_cases.postconditions: Plate number confirmed (read or manual) and passed to vehicle entry
use_cases.trigger: Vehicle stops at the entry gate

use_cases.title: Assign nearest slot
use_cases.goal: Park as close to the gate as possible
use_cases.preconditions: A free slot of the vehicle type exists
use_cases.main_flow: System receives the vehicle type from the gate;System lists the free slots of that type;System computes the distance of each slot to the gate;System assigns the slot with the shortest distance;System shows the route to the slot
use_cases.alternative_flows: [step 4] If the nearest zone is locked or full, system assigns the next nearest slot;[step 4] If several slots have equal distance, system assigns the first in tree order
use_cases.postconditions: Nearest free slot assigned and route shown

use_cases.title: Detect parking violation
use_cases.goal: Be alerted to wrong-slot parking, overstay and sensor faults
use_cases.main_flow: Slot Sensor reports the occupancy of each slot;System compares the readings with the ticket records;System detects a mismatch;System raises an alert to the attendant;Attendant moves the ticket to the slot where the vehicle really is and the system rescans
use_cases.alternative_flows: [step 3, exception] If a Slot Sensor sends no heartbeat, system blocks the slot and raises a sensor-fault alert;[step 3] If a vehicle has stayed longer than 24 hours, system raises an overstay alert
use_cases.postconditions: Alerts raised and logged; ticket matches the sensors; faulty slots blocked

use_cases.title: Emergency evacuation
use_cases.goal: Let all vehicles leave quickly and stop new entries
use_cases.main_flow: Administrator triggers the evacuation;System opens all entry and exit barriers;System locks the whole lot so that no new ticket is issued and cancels all reservations;System shows the evacuation message on all floors;System logs the evacuation start and the operator;Administrator ends the evacuation and the system closes the barriers and unlocks the lot
use_cases.alternative_flows: [step 1, exception] If the account is not an administrator, system denies access;[step 1] If the Fire Alarm sends the signal, system starts the evacuation without operator login;[step 6, exception] If an attendant tries to end the evacuation, system denies access
use_cases.postconditions: Barriers open during the evacuation and closed after it; exits free of charge; lot normal again

use_cases.title: Pay dynamic fee
use_cases.goal: Pay a fee that reflects peak hours and lot occupancy
use_cases.main_flow: Driver presents the ticket at the exit gate;System splits the stay into started hours;System applies the peak-hour multiplier to each hour that starts in a peak period;System applies the occupancy surcharge recorded at entry;System shows the fee breakdown and the driver pays
use_cases.alternative_flows: [step 3] If the stay has no peak hours and occupancy was at most 80% at entry, system charges the base rate;[step 3] If the vehicle is a motorbike, the same multipliers apply to the motorbike rate;[step 2] If the stay is 15 minutes or less, system charges nothing (grace period);[step 3] If the fee of a started 24 hours exceeds 10 hourly rates, system charges the daily cap for that day
use_cases.postconditions: Ticket closed; dynamic fee recorded

use_cases.title: Log in
use_cases.goal: Authenticate to use staff functions
use_cases.preconditions: The account exists and is not locked
use_cases.main_flow: User enters the account name and password;System checks the credentials;System determines the role of the account;System grants the functions of that role and logs the login
use_cases.alternative_flows: [step 2, exception] If the credentials are wrong, system rejects the login and counts the failed attempt;[step 2, exception] After 3 consecutive failed attempts, system locks the account and logs the incident
use_cases.postconditions: Session role set; failures logged

use_cases.title: Cancel a reservation
use_cases.goal: Cancel a reservation that is no longer needed
use_cases.preconditions: A reservation exists for the plate
use_cases.main_flow: Driver enters the plate number;System finds the reservation;Driver confirms the cancellation;System releases the slot and logs the cancellation
use_cases.alternative_flows: [step 2] If no reservation exists, system shows 'reservation not found';[step 2] If the reservation already expired after the 15 minute hold, system shows 'reservation expired'
use_cases.postconditions: Reservation removed; slot free for other vehicles

use_cases.title: Configure lot and rates
use_cases.goal: Change the hourly rate or add a zone while the lot is running
use_cases.main_flow: Administrator authenticates <<include UC-12>>;Administrator chooses to change a rate or add a zone;System validates the input;System applies the change;System logs the change
use_cases.alternative_flows: [step 4] Vehicles already parked keep the rate of their ticket;[step 3, exception] If the input is invalid (rate not positive, duplicate zone name), system rejects it;[step 1, exception] If the account is not an administrator, system denies access
use_cases.postconditions: New rate applies to new tickets; new zone slots are assignable
use_cases.trigger: Operator changes pricing or extends the lot

use_cases.title: View availability
use_cases.goal: See where free slots are before entering
use_cases.main_flow: Driver looks at the availability display;System counts the free slots per floor and zone;System displays the counts
use_cases.alternative_flows: [step 2] If a floor or zone is locked or evacuating, system shows 0 free slots for it
use_cases.postconditions: Counts displayed and equal to the real slot states

use_cases.title: Generate revenue and audit report
use_cases.goal: Review revenue and audited transactions of a period
use_cases.main_flow: Parking Manager authenticates <<include UC-12>>;Parking Manager selects a period;System collects the payments and lost-ticket charges of the period;System groups the revenue per floor and zone;System shows the report and the audit log entries of the period
use_cases.alternative_flows: [step 3] If no transaction exists in the period, system shows zero revenue;[step 1, exception] If the account is an attendant, system denies access
use_cases.postconditions: Report displayed; nothing changed
use_cases.trigger: Manager prepares a review or an audit

use_cases.title: Override a fee
use_cases.goal: Correct a wrong fee with the approval of a manager
use_cases.main_flow: Attendant authenticates <<include UC-12>>;Attendant enters the plate, the corrected amount and the reason;System validates the input and records a pending override request;Parking Manager reviews the request and approves it;System applies the approved amount to the ticket and logs the request and the decision
use_cases.alternative_flows: [step 3, exception] If the reason is empty or the amount is negative, system rejects the request;[step 4] If the Parking Manager rejects the request, system keeps the calculated fee;[step 4, exception] If an attendant tries to approve, system denies access
use_cases.postconditions: Ticket carries the approved amount; request and decision logged

use_cases.title: Park with a monthly or VIP pass
use_cases.goal: Park without an hourly fee and, with a VIP pass, in a VIP slot
use_cases.preconditions: The administrator registered a pass for the plate
use_cases.main_flow: Driver arrives at the entry gate with a registered plate;System identifies the plate <<include UC-07>>;System finds a valid pass for the plate;System assigns a slot, a VIP slot first for a VIP pass;System issues a ticket marked with the pass type and opens the entry barrier;System charges no parking fee at the exit
use_cases.alternative_flows: [step 3] If the pass has ended, system logs the expiry and treats the vehicle as a normal visitor;[step 4] If the pass is a monthly pass, system assigns an ordinary slot and never a VIP slot;[step 6] If the vehicle is an EV, system still bills the charged energy
use_cases.postconditions: Ticket closed; parking free of charge
use_cases.trigger: Pass holder arrives at the gate

use_cases.title: Register a pass
use_cases.goal: Give a plate a monthly or VIP pass, or remove it
use_cases.main_flow: Administrator authenticates <<include UC-12>>;Administrator enters the plate, the pass type and the end date;System validates the input;System stores the pass and logs the registration
use_cases.alternative_flows: [step 3, exception] If the pass type is unknown or the end date is in the past, system rejects the input;[step 1, exception] If the account is not an administrator, system denies access;[step 4, exception] If the Central Server is unreachable, system refuses the registration;[step 2] If the administrator removes a pass, system deletes it and logs the removal
use_cases.postconditions: Pass stored or removed; change logged
use_cases.trigger: Customer buys or ends a pass

use_cases.title: Charge an electric vehicle
use_cases.goal: Park an EV at a charging slot and pay for the energy
use_cases.main_flow: Driver arrives at the entry gate with an EV;System assigns the nearest free EV slot <<include UC-08>>;Charging Station reports the energy charged in kWh;System adds the energy price to the fee at the exit;Driver pays the total at the exit
use_cases.alternative_flows: [step 2] If no EV slot is free, system rejects the entry;[step 2] If the vehicle is a car, system never assigns an EV slot;[step 3, exception] If the energy reading is zero or negative, system rejects the reading
use_cases.postconditions: Ticket closed; parking and energy paid

use_cases.title: Verify plate at exit
use_cases.goal: Leave only with the vehicle that matches the ticket
use_cases.main_flow: Exit Camera reads the plate of the vehicle at the exit gate;System finds the ticket presented by the driver;System compares the plate read with the plate of the ticket;System accepts the match and releases the vehicle for payment
use_cases.alternative_flows: [step 3, exception] If the plates differ, the barrier stays closed and the system logs the mismatch and alerts the attendant;[step 3] If an attendant verifies the vehicle and approves, system lets it leave and logs the approval;[step 1] If the Exit Camera cannot read the plate, system treats it as a mismatch
use_cases.postconditions: Vehicle released or held; mismatch logged
use_cases.trigger: Vehicle stops at the exit gate

use_cases.title: Work offline
use_cases.goal: Keep the gates running while the central server is unreachable
use_cases.preconditions: Gates and local data are available
use_cases.main_flow: Central Server connection is lost;System switches the gates to local mode and logs the event;Drivers enter and leave as usual with cash or card payment;System marks every record made in local mode;Connection returns and the system synchronizes the marked records and logs their number
use_cases.alternative_flows: [step 3] If a driver chooses online payment, system refuses it and asks for cash or card;[step 3, exception] If a driver asks for a reservation or the administrator registers a pass, system refuses it until the connection returns;[step 3] If an evacuation is triggered in local mode, the barriers open as usual
use_cases.postconditions: No record lost; marks cleared after synchronization

change_requests.title: Add peak-hour pricing
change_requests.description: Extend REQ-03 so the hourly rate is higher during peak hours.
change_requests.impact_analysis: Requires a time-based rate table; moderate cost impact.
change_requests.decision_rationale: Approved and implemented: peak-hour multiplier (REQ-16) and occupancy surcharge (REQ-17).

change_requests.title: Add EV charging slots
change_requests.description: Introduce an EV vehicle type with dedicated charging zones.
change_requests.impact_analysis: Requires a new slot type and zone configuration.
change_requests.decision_rationale: Approved and implemented: EV vehicle type, EV charging zones (REQ-24) and energy fee (REQ-25).

hazards.mitigation: Encrypt backups; restrict backup access; audit access logs.

hazards.cause: Rounding or timezone bug in duration logic
hazards.mitigation: Unit tests for date/time edge cases; manual override with attendant approval.

hazards.cause: Two vehicles enter at the same time and receive the same slot
hazards.effect: Dispute at the gate, entry delay
hazards.mitigation: Assign slots atomically; reject a slot that is already occupied.
Safety-rated presence sensor; barrier stays open on sensor fault.

hazards.cause: Weak access control on admin functions
hazards.effect: Data integrity loss, lot capacity wrong
hazards.mitigation: Authenticate staff with a password; lock the account after 3 failed attempts; restrict admin functions to the administrator role.

hazards.cause: Rain or dirt lowers camera image quality
hazards.mitigation: Accept reads only at confidence >= 80%; below that require manual entry by the attendant.

hazards.cause: Controller fault or power loss during evacuation
hazards.mitigation: Barriers fail open on power loss; evacuation overrides payment; manual release key.

hazards.cause: Sensor fault or vehicle parked across two slots
hazards.effect: Slot shown free while occupied, or the reverse
hazards.mitigation: Reconcile readings with tickets on every scan; block slots whose sensor is silent.

hazards.cause: Peak multiplier and occupancy surcharge stack
hazards.mitigation: Fixed multipliers (1.5 and 1.25) so the maximum is 1.875 times base; show fee breakdown before payment.

hazards.hazard: Vehicle leaves with another vehicle's ticket
hazards.cause: Ticket swap or tailgating at the exit
hazards.effect: Theft of a parked vehicle, revenue loss
hazards.mitigation: Compare the exit plate with the ticket plate; keep the barrier closed on a mismatch; attendant approval needed.

hazards.effect: Queues at the gates, vehicles blocked
hazards.mitigation: Gates work from local data; online payment refused with a cash/card fallback; records marked and synchronized on recovery.

hazards.cause: An attendant lowers fees for acquaintances
hazards.mitigation: Two-person rule: a manager or administrator approves; a reason is required; request and decision are audited.

elicitation_sessions.findings: Attendants need fast entry (<10s), a clear view of free slots, and a way to handle lost tickets.

elicitation_sessions.objective: Prioritize the feature backlog with all stakeholder groups.
elicitation_sessions.findings: Security, availability and audit were rated top concerns.

elicitation_sessions.objective: Gauge driver expectations for reservation and vehicle location.
elicitation_sessions.findings: 65% of respondents want to reserve a slot; 50% want to find their car by plate.

elicitation_sessions.objective: Observe the entry gate and an evacuation drill.
elicitation_sessions.findings: Camera misreads plates in rain; attendants want alerts for wrong-slot parking; barriers must open within 5 s in a drill.
Operator wants peak and occupancy pricing; drivers want the closest slot.

tools.name: Jira
tools.limitations: Requires discipline to keep in sync with SRS.

tools.name: PlantUML / Mermaid
tools.purpose: Render use-case, state and data-flow diagrams from text.
tools.limitations: Limited layout control for large diagrams.

tools.name: SPS terminal tool (parking.py)
tools.purpose: Load this dataset, check quality, trace, simulate and test requirements.
tools.strengths: Single script, data kept in one xlsx file.

test_cases.title: Entry assigns the nearest free slot of the matching type
test_cases.preconditions: Lot has a free car slot.
test_cases.steps: Vehicle arrives at gate;System reads plate and type;System assigns slot
test_cases.expected_result: Ticket created and the nearest free car slot is assigned.
test_cases.actual_result: Ticket issued; slot A1 assigned.

test_cases.title: Entry is rejected when the zone is full
test_cases.preconditions: All moto slots are occupied.
test_cases.steps: Moto arrives at gate;Observe system response
test_cases.expected_result: System rejects entry with a 'zone full' message.
test_cases.actual_result: Entry rejected ('zone full'); rejection logged.

test_cases.title: Fee is calculated correctly for a 2h30 stay
test_cases.preconditions: Car ticket with entry time 08:00.
test_cases.steps: Present ticket at 10:30;System calculates fee
test_cases.expected_result: Fee equals 3 started hours x 10000 = 30000 VND.
test_cases.actual_result: Fee = 30000 VND.

test_cases.title: Slot assignment responds within 1 second under normal load
test_cases.preconditions: Lot contains the standard simulated slot set.
test_cases.steps: Run 1000 entry requests;Measure response times;Compute 95th percentile
test_cases.expected_result: 95th percentile response time is <= 1 second (NFR-01 target).
test_cases.actual_result: p95 = 1.617 ms over 1000 requests.

test_cases.title: Reserved slot is not given to another vehicle
test_cases.preconditions: Slot A1 is reserved for plate VIP-1.
test_cases.steps: Another car enters;System assigns slot;VIP-1 enters
test_cases.expected_result: Other car does not get A1; VIP-1 gets A1.
test_cases.actual_result: Other car got A2; VIP-1 got A1.

test_cases.title: Vehicle is located by plate number
test_cases.preconditions: Three vehicles are parked.
test_cases.steps: Enter plate number;System searches active tickets
test_cases.expected_result: System returns floor, zone and slot of the vehicle.
test_cases.actual_result: Found: Smart Parking > F1 > A > A2.

test_cases.title: Peak-hour rate is applied once CR-01 is implemented
test_cases.preconditions: CR-01 (peak-hour pricing) is implemented; vehicle exits after a peak-hour stay.
test_cases.steps: Set clock to peak hour;Present ticket;System calculates fee
test_cases.expected_result: Fee uses the peak-hour rate.
test_cases.actual_result: CR-01 implemented: 17:00-18:00 charged 15000 VND (1.5 x 10000).

test_cases.title: Attendant account cannot lock a zone
test_cases.preconditions: An attendant account is logged in.
test_cases.steps: Attempt to lock zone A
test_cases.expected_result: Access is denied with an authorization error.
test_cases.actual_result: PermissionError raised; denial logged.

test_cases.title: Locked zone is not assigned to new vehicles
test_cases.preconditions: Zone A is locked.
test_cases.steps: Car arrives at gate;System assigns slot
test_cases.expected_result: System assigns a slot outside zone A.
test_cases.actual_result: Car assigned C1 (zone A blocked).

test_cases.title: Lost ticket is charged the maximum daily fee plus penalty
test_cases.preconditions: Car is parked; driver has no ticket.
test_cases.steps: Enter plate number;System looks up entry record;System charges fee
test_cases.expected_result: System charges the maximum daily fee plus the penalty.

test_cases.title: Plate with high confidence is accepted automatically
test_cases.preconditions: Entry camera is online.
test_cases.steps: Capture plate image at 95% quality;System reads plate
test_cases.expected_result: Plate is accepted without attendant input.
test_cases.actual_result: Plate 29A-111 accepted at 95% confidence.

test_cases.title: Plate with low confidence requires manual entry
test_cases.preconditions: Entry camera is online.
test_cases.steps: Capture plate image at 55% quality;System reads plate;Attendant enters plate
test_cases.expected_result: System asks for manual entry and accepts the typed plate.
test_cases.actual_result: 55% confidence: manual entry requested and accepted.

test_cases.title: Camera offline falls back to manual entry
test_cases.preconditions: Entry camera is offline.
test_cases.steps: Vehicle stops at gate;System requests the image
test_cases.expected_result: Manual entry is required and the fault is logged.
test_cases.actual_result: Manual entry required; camera_offline logged.

test_cases.title: Nearest free slot is assigned
test_cases.preconditions: Zone B is closer to the gate than zone A.
test_cases.steps: Car arrives at gate;System assigns slot
test_cases.expected_result: Car is assigned the slot with the shortest distance (B1), not the first in tree order.
test_cases.actual_result: Assigned B1 (10 m), not A1 (40 m).

test_cases.title: Next nearest slot is assigned when the nearest zone is locked
test_cases.preconditions: Nearest zone B is locked.
test_cases.steps: Car arrives at gate;System assigns slot
test_cases.expected_result: Car is assigned the nearest slot outside zone B.
test_cases.actual_result: Zone B locked: assigned A1.

test_cases.title: Sensor mismatch raises alerts
test_cases.preconditions: Ticketed car in A1; sensors show A1 empty and A2 occupied.
test_cases.steps: Run sensor scan;Read alerts
test_cases.expected_result: Alerts for the missing ticketed vehicle in A1 and the unauthorized vehicle in A2.
test_cases.actual_result: Alerts: missing_vehicle, unauthorized_vehicle.

test_cases.title: Silent sensor blocks its slot
test_cases.preconditions: Slot B2 is free.
test_cases.steps: Sensor of B2 sends no heartbeat;Run sensor scan;Sensor recovers;Run sensor scan
test_cases.expected_result: B2 is blocked with a fault alert, then freed when the sensor recovers.
test_cases.actual_result: B2 blocked on silence, freed on recovery.

test_cases.title: Overstay alert after 24 hours
test_cases.preconditions: A car has been parked for 25 hours.
test_cases.steps: Run sensor scan;Read alerts
test_cases.expected_result: An overstay alert is raised for the car.
test_cases.actual_result: 29A-111 parked 25 h in A1 (limit 24 h)

test_cases.title: Evacuation opens barriers and stops new entries
test_cases.preconditions: Cars are parked; administrator is logged in.
test_cases.steps: Trigger evacuation;Try a new entry;Exit a parked car
test_cases.expected_result: Barriers open, new entry rejected, exit free of charge.
test_cases.actual_result: Barriers open; entry rejected; exit charged 0 VND.

test_cases.title: Attendant cannot trigger evacuation
test_cases.preconditions: An attendant account is logged in.
test_cases.steps: Attempt to trigger evacuation
test_cases.expected_result: Access is denied with an authorization error.
test_cases.actual_result: PermissionError raised; denial logged.

test_cases.title: Fire alarm starts evacuation without login
test_cases.preconditions: No operator is logged in.
test_cases.steps: Fire alarm sends the signal
test_cases.expected_result: Evacuation starts and barriers open.
test_cases.actual_result: Evacuation started by fire alarm; barriers open.

test_cases.title: Barriers open within 5 seconds of the evacuation trigger
test_cases.preconditions: Lot with 1000 slots and 500 parked cars.
test_cases.steps: Trigger evacuation;Measure time until all barriers are open
test_cases.expected_result: Time is <= 5 seconds (NFR-06 target).
test_cases.actual_result: Barriers open in 0.674 ms (500 cars parked).

test_cases.title: Peak-hour multiplier applies only to peak hours
test_cases.preconditions: Car enters at 16:30 local time.
test_cases.steps: Exit at 18:30;System calculates fee
test_cases.expected_result: Hour starting 16:30 costs 10000 and hour starting 17:30 costs 15000: total 25000 VND.

test_cases.title: Occupancy surcharge applies above 80% occupancy
test_cases.preconditions: Three of four car slots are occupied.
test_cases.steps: Fourth car enters;Fourth car exits after 1 hour off-peak
test_cases.expected_result: Fee is 125% of the base fee: 12500 VND.
test_cases.actual_result: 3rd car base fee; 4th car (100% occupancy) 12500 VND = 125% of 10000.

test_cases.title: Barrier opens only after payment is made
test_cases.preconditions: A car is parked with an active ticket.
test_cases.steps: Present the ticket at exit;Payment fails;Observe the barrier and the slot;Pay again;Observe the barrier and the slot
test_cases.expected_result: After the failed payment the barrier stays closed and the slot occupied; after payment the slot is freed and the barrier opens.
test_cases.actual_result: Failed payment: slot stays occupied; after payment the slot is free.

test_cases.title: Exit with an unknown ticket is refused
test_cases.preconditions: No ticket exists for plate NOPE.
test_cases.steps: Present ticket NOPE at the exit gate
test_cases.expected_result: Exit refused; the driver is directed to the attendant.
test_cases.actual_result: Exit refused: ticket not found.

test_cases.title: Reservation is rejected when no slot is free
test_cases.preconditions: All car slots are reserved.
test_cases.steps: Request a reservation for another car
test_cases.expected_result: Reservation rejected.
test_cases.actual_result: 5th reservation rejected (4 car slots reserved).

test_cases.title: No-show reservation is released after 15 minutes
test_cases.preconditions: A slot is reserved for a 10:30 arrival.
test_cases.steps: Advance the clock to 10:46;Run reservation expiry
test_cases.expected_result: The slot is free again.
test_cases.actual_result: A1 released at 10:46.

test_cases.title: Locate rejects an unknown plate
test_cases.preconditions: No vehicle with plate NOPE is parked.
test_cases.steps: Search plate NOPE
test_cases.expected_result: System reports 'vehicle not found'.
test_cases.actual_result: Plate NOPE: vehicle not found.

test_cases.title: Occupied slot stays occupied when its zone is locked
test_cases.preconditions: A car is parked in A1.
test_cases.steps: Lock zone A;Check A1;Car exits;Check A1
test_cases.expected_result: A1 stays occupied after the lock and becomes blocked after the exit.
test_cases.actual_result: A1 occupied after lock; blocked after exit.

test_cases.title: Lost ticket without an entry record is escalated
test_cases.preconditions: No entry record exists for the plate.
test_cases.steps: Enter the plate at the lost-ticket function
test_cases.expected_result: System reports 'no entry record' so that the attendant escalates to the Parking Manager.
test_cases.actual_result: no entry record: escalate to the Parking Manager.

test_cases.title: Lost ticket without proof of ownership is refused
test_cases.preconditions: A car is parked; the driver cannot prove ownership.
test_cases.steps: Enter the plate;Ownership check fails
test_cases.expected_result: Exit refused and the refusal is logged.
test_cases.actual_result: Exit refused; refusal logged.

test_cases.title: Valid login returns the account role
test_cases.preconditions: Account admin1 exists.
test_cases.steps: Enter account admin1 and its password
test_cases.expected_result: Login succeeds with role admin.
test_cases.actual_result: admin1 logged in with role admin.

test_cases.title: Wrong password is rejected
test_cases.preconditions: Account admin1 exists.
test_cases.steps: Enter account admin1 with a wrong password
test_cases.expected_result: Login rejected and the failed attempt counted.
test_cases.actual_result: Login rejected; failed attempts: 1.

test_cases.title: Account is locked after 3 failed attempts
test_cases.preconditions: Account admin1 exists.
test_cases.steps: Fail the login three times;Log in with the correct password
test_cases.expected_result: Account is locked; even the correct password is refused.
test_cases.actual_result: account locked (correct password refused after 3 failures).

test_cases.title: Cancelling a reservation frees the slot
test_cases.preconditions: Slot A1 is reserved for VIP-1.
test_cases.steps: Cancel the reservation of VIP-1;Another car enters
test_cases.expected_result: The slot is released and assigned to the other car.
test_cases.actual_result: A1 released and assigned to the next car.

test_cases.title: Cancelling a missing reservation is reported
test_cases.preconditions: No reservation exists for plate NOPE.
test_cases.steps: Cancel the reservation of NOPE
test_cases.expected_result: System reports 'reservation not found'.
test_cases.actual_result: Cancel NOPE: reservation not found.

test_cases.title: Rate change applies to new tickets only
test_cases.preconditions: Car A is parked at 10000 per hour.
test_cases.steps: Administrator sets the car rate to 12000;Car B enters;Both exit after one hour
test_cases.expected_result: Car A pays 10000 and car B pays 12000.
test_cases.actual_result: Car A pays 10000; car B pays 12000.

test_cases.title: Zone added at runtime is assignable at once
test_cases.preconditions: All car slots are occupied.
test_cases.steps: Administrator adds zone D with 2 car slots on floor F2;A car enters
test_cases.expected_result: The car is assigned a slot of the new zone D.
test_cases.actual_result: Zone D added; the next car got D1.

test_cases.title: Attendant cannot change rates or add zones
test_cases.preconditions: An attendant account is logged in.
test_cases.steps: Attempt to change the car rate;Attempt to add a zone
test_cases.expected_result: Both attempts are denied.
test_cases.actual_result: Both attempts denied.

test_cases.title: Availability counts match the slot states
test_cases.preconditions: A car is parked in A1 and A2 is reserved.
test_cases.steps: Read the availability display
test_cases.expected_result: Zone A shows 0/2 free, floor F1 shows 2/4 free and the lot shows 4/6 free.
test_cases.actual_result: A 0/2, F1 2/4, lot 4/6 free.

test_cases.title: Revenue per zone and floor sums to the total
test_cases.preconditions: Cars have paid when leaving zones A and C.
test_cases.steps: Generate the report for the period
test_cases.expected_result: Zone revenues add up to the floor revenues and to the total.

test_cases.title: Audit log records entry, payment and exit
test_cases.preconditions: The lot is empty.
test_cases.steps: A car enters;The car pays and exits;Read the audit log
test_cases.expected_result: The log holds entry, payment and exit records with timestamps.
test_cases.actual_result: Audit events: entry, payment, exit.

test_cases.title: Ending an evacuation restores normal operation
test_cases.preconditions: An evacuation is in progress.
test_cases.steps: Administrator ends the evacuation;A car enters
test_cases.expected_result: Barriers are closed, slots unblocked and the new entry accepted.
test_cases.actual_result: Barriers closed, slots unblocked, new entry accepted.

test_cases.title: Evacuation cancels reservations
test_cases.preconditions: A slot is reserved.
test_cases.steps: Trigger the evacuation
test_cases.expected_result: The reservation is cancelled and the slot blocked.
test_cases.actual_result: Reservation cancelled; A1 blocked.

test_cases.title: Locked zone shows zero free slots
test_cases.preconditions: Zone A has free slots.
test_cases.steps: Lock zone A;Read the availability display
test_cases.expected_result: Zone A shows 0 free slots.
test_cases.actual_result: Zone A shows 0 free slots.

test_cases.title: Report for a period without payments shows zero
test_cases.preconditions: No payment happened in the chosen period.
test_cases.steps: Generate the report for that period
test_cases.expected_result: Revenue is 0 and the transaction count is 0.
test_cases.actual_result: Revenue 0, 0 payments.

test_cases.title: A stay of 15 minutes is free
test_cases.preconditions: Car ticket with entry time 10:00.
test_cases.steps: Present the ticket at 10:15;Present another ticket at 10:16
test_cases.expected_result: 10:15 costs 0 VND; 10:16 costs one started hour (10000 VND).
test_cases.actual_result: 15 min = 0 VND; 16 min = 10000 VND.

test_cases.title: The fee of a started 24 hours is capped
test_cases.preconditions: Car ticket with entry time 10:00.
test_cases.steps: Present the ticket after 24 hours;Present another ticket after 25 hours
test_cases.expected_result: 24 hours cost 100000 VND (cap); 25 hours cost 110000 VND.

test_cases.title: An approved fee override replaces the calculated fee
test_cases.preconditions: Car parked for 2 hours; attendant and manager logged in.
test_cases.steps: Attendant requests 5000 VND with a reason;Manager approves;Car exits
test_cases.expected_result: Fee is 5000 VND; request and approval are logged.
test_cases.actual_result: ticket fee 5000 VND (was 20000); exit charged 5000; logged: override_requested, override_approved

test_cases.title: Invalid, unapproved or rejected overrides do not change the fee
test_cases.preconditions: Car parked for 2 hours.
test_cases.steps: Request without a reason;Attendant approves;Manager rejects;Car exits
test_cases.expected_result: The calculated fee 20000 VND is charged; the denial is logged.
test_cases.actual_result: rejected: override needs a non-negative amount and a reason; manager rejects OV-1: fee stays 20000 VND; attendant approval denied: manager or admin only

test_cases.title: A monthly pass parks free of charge
test_cases.preconditions: Plate 29A-111 holds a monthly pass valid until 2026-12-31.
test_cases.steps: Car enters;Car exits after 5 hours
test_cases.expected_result: Fee is 0 VND for parking.
test_cases.actual_result: Monthly pass: 5 h stay costs 0 VND.

test_cases.title: Only VIP pass holders get VIP slots
test_cases.preconditions: Zone V (VIP) is closest to the gate; one VIP and one monthly holder.
test_cases.steps: VIP holder enters;Monthly holder enters;Ordinary car enters
test_cases.expected_result: VIP holder gets V1; the others get ordinary slots.
test_cases.actual_result: VIP holder: V1; monthly holder: A1; ordinary car: A2.

test_cases.title: An expired pass pays the normal fee
test_cases.preconditions: Pass ended on 2026-10-10.
test_cases.steps: Car enters;Car exits after 2 hours
test_cases.expected_result: Expiry logged; fee is 20000 VND.
test_cases.actual_result: Expired pass: expiry logged, fee 20000 VND.

test_cases.title: Administrator registers and removes a pass
test_cases.preconditions: Administrator logged in; central server reachable.
test_cases.steps: Register a monthly pass;Remove the pass
test_cases.expected_result: Pass stored then deleted; both logged.
test_cases.actual_result: pass stored; logged: pass_added (monthly until 2026-11-16); MON-1 removed; removal logged

test_cases.title: Invalid, unauthorized or offline pass registration is refused
test_cases.preconditions: Attendant logged in; central server reachable.
test_cases.steps: Register with a wrong type;Register with a past date;Attendant registers;Register while offline
test_cases.expected_result: All four attempts are refused.
test_cases.actual_result: rejected: invalid pass (kind monthly|vip, end date in the future); invalid pass (kind monthly|vip, end date in the future); attendant denied: administrator only; refused: pass registration needs the central server (offline mode)

test_cases.title: EVs get EV slots and cars never do
test_cases.preconditions: Zone E has 2 EV slots.
test_cases.steps: EV enters;Second EV enters;Third EV enters;Car enters
test_cases.expected_result: EVs get E1 and E2; the third EV is rejected; the car gets an ordinary slot.
test_cases.actual_result: EVs got E1 and E2; third EV rejected; the car got A1.

test_cases.title: The energy price is added to the fee
test_cases.preconditions: EV parked for 2 hours in E1.
test_cases.steps: Charger reports 10 kWh;EV exits
test_cases.actual_result: Fee 59000 VND (24000 parking + 35000 energy).

test_cases.title: A bad energy reading is rejected
test_cases.preconditions: EV and car parked.
test_cases.steps: Report 0 kWh for the EV;Report 5 kWh for the car
test_cases.expected_result: Both readings are rejected.
test_cases.actual_result: 0 kWh and a car reading were rejected.

test_cases.title: A matching exit plate lets the vehicle leave
test_cases.preconditions: Car parked with an active ticket.
test_cases.steps: Exit camera reads the same plate;Pay
test_cases.expected_result: The vehicle leaves.
test_cases.actual_result: Matching plate: vehicle left.

test_cases.title: A plate mismatch keeps the barrier closed
test_cases.preconditions: Cars 29A-111 and 29A-222 parked.
test_cases.steps: Present the ticket of 29A-111 while the camera reads 29A-222
test_cases.expected_result: Exit refused; mismatch logged; slot still occupied.
test_cases.actual_result: Mismatch: exit refused, slot still occupied, mismatch logged.

test_cases.title: An attendant can approve a mismatch or an unreadable plate
test_cases.preconditions: A mismatch is pending.
test_cases.steps: Attendant approves;Camera cannot read the plate;Guest tries to approve
test_cases.expected_result: Attendant approval lets the vehicle leave and is logged; a guest approval is refused.
test_cases.actual_result: attendant approves: vehicle leaves (10000 VND), approval logged; unreadable plate: barrier stays closed; a guest cannot approve

test_cases.title: Gates keep working offline
test_cases.preconditions: Network is down.
test_cases.steps: Car enters;Car exits paying cash
test_cases.expected_result: Entry and exit succeed; records carry an offline mark.
test_cases.actual_result: Offline: entry and cash exit worked; 3 records marked.

test_cases.title: Online payment and reservations are refused offline
test_cases.preconditions: Network is down.
test_cases.steps: Pay online;Reserve a slot
test_cases.expected_result: Both are refused with a clear message; cash still works.
test_cases.actual_result: online refused: payment gateway unavailable: pay cash or card at the booth; slot Occupied; refused offline: reservation needs the central server (offline mode); pass registration needs the central server (offline mode)

test_cases.title: Records are synchronized when the network returns
test_cases.preconditions: Records were made offline.
test_cases.steps: Network returns
test_cases.expected_result: Marks are cleared and the number of records is logged.
test_cases.actual_result: 1 record synchronized; marks cleared; count logged.

test_cases.title: Evacuation works offline
test_cases.preconditions: Network is down; cars parked.
test_cases.steps: Fire alarm starts the evacuation;A car exits
test_cases.expected_result: Barriers open and the exit is free.
test_cases.actual_result: evacuation offline: barriers OPEN, exit free of charge

test_cases.title: Barrier stays open while a vehicle is present or the sensor fails
test_cases.preconditions: Entry barrier is open.
test_cases.steps: Close with a vehicle present;Close with a sensor fault;Close with power lost;Close with the way clear
test_cases.expected_result: Barrier stays open and the refusal is logged in the first three cases; it closes in the fourth.
test_cases.actual_result: Barrier stayed open with a vehicle present, a sensor fault, and power loss (3 refusals logged); closed when clear.
